messages:
maria: FYI customer Z asked for a scoped private pilot in Q3. We need to align product scope, runtime perf changes, infra slots, and security checklist ASAP. Who's in for async planning?

josh: Count me in. Need a clear perf baseline otherwise we won't be comfortable with SLAs.

anika: Runtime: baseline quant + KV-cache sanity check. I estimate 7-10 working days to produce a validated perf profile for their model size (2B).

ben: Infra: we can reserve a 2xA10 cluster in staging but need budget signoff. Also clarify whether pilot needs VPC peering or isolated private deploy. That changes network config and time.

harry: Security: for pilot we'll do scoped controls: KMS integration, audit logging, and a threat checklist. Light review = 4 business days. Full compliance review will be longer.

maria: Proposed minimal path: (1) runtime completes quant+KV checks, (2) infra provisions staging with network decision, (3) security runs light review. Product will own acceptance criteria and rollout checklist.

josh: If runtime changes require kernel updates, that could add another week. Can we define a fallback: run pilot on hosted with strict rate limits to keep schedule? Tradeoff = higher cost, less realistic infra.

anika: Noted. I'll post a short RFC to #eng-runtime tomorrow with perf numbers and register the kernel change if needed. Ticket: RUN-2026.

ben: I opened INFRA-9002 for budgeting and cluster reservation. Quote attached in the ticket: estimated $9k/mo for reserved nodes, provisioning lead time ~4 days after approval.

harry: Also need to confirm key management approach. Customer wants customer-managed keys; that triggers HSM path. HSM onboarding adds ~10 business days. Can we scope pilot to use managed KMS first?

maria: Let's scope pilot to managed KMS to hit the timeline, note HSM as a phase 2 requirement. Will document in the checklist.

celine: Oncall/runbook items: define abort conditions (latency > threshold, error rate spike), canary traffic % (~5%), and a rollback plan that disables private routes but keeps hosted fallback. I'll draft runbook fragments.

josh: Perf SLO ask from customer: p95 <=150ms for short prompts, p99 <=450ms. We should confirm these after runtime baseline.

anika: Agreed. If baseline misses p99 we may require batching or model variant changes which affects infra.

maria: Action items: anika -> RFC + perf baseline by 2026-04-08; ben -> budget approval path + provisioning ETA by 2026-04-01; harry -> light review completion estimate and checklist items by 2026-04-05; celine -> initial runbook draft by 2026-04-06.

infra-bot: Calendar invite created: "Customer Z pilot sync" 2026-04-02 09:30. Attendees: maria, josh, anika, ben, harry, celine.

maria: Thanks all. If any blockers pop up please flag here with links to PRs/tickets. I'll compile the prelaunch checklist after sync and share in #product.
